name: gizza-ai/protobuf-decode
summary: Decode raw protobuf wire bytes into a field/wire-type tree without a .proto schema.

tool.description: Decode raw Protocol Buffers (protobuf) wire bytes into a field-number / wire-type tree WITHOUT a .proto schema. Give the wire bytes as base64 or hex in 'input' (set encoding='auto' (default), 'base64', or 'hex'). Each field is reported by its field number, raw wire type (varint / fixed32 / fixed64 / length_delimited) and every plausible interpretation; length-delimited fields are recursively parsed as nested messages when they parse cleanly. Use format='json' (default) for a structured tree or 'text' for a compact outline.

input.description: The raw protobuf wire bytes, as a base64 or hex string.

encoding.description: How the input bytes are encoded.
